ig:
Onboarding stalls when one document is missing and nobody chases it.

This concept demo (sample data) shows the flow in n8n:
1. The application arrives by webhook
2. The workflow checks the document checklist
3. It emails an upload link for the missing item only
4. After 48 hours: one more reminder, then a task for the ops team
5. When everything is in, reminders stop and status moves to review

No decisions are automated here, only the chasing.

Running onboarding for a fintech or lending product? DM REVIEW.

li:
A short look at how we release software.

Before anything goes live:
→ Every change is reviewed by a second engineer
→ Automated tests run, including browser tests on the journeys that matter \(sign-up, checkout, booking\)
→ It runs on staging with realistic test data, never real customer data
→ Key pages are checked on real phone and browser sizes
→ Release goes out with error monitoring, so issues reach us before users report them

We also run QA and test automation as a standalone service for existing products: https://xenovasolutions.com/contact
